messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: edge-pop us-east-1 (pop-edge-us-east1) — elevated packet loss detected by edge-health-monitor. Observed loss: 15-30% for egress toward multiple upstreams. Start time ~2026-03-15T14:02:00Z. Auto-page oncall.
Maya J: Acked. Paging SRE oncall.
Kevin_R: I'm oncall, taking this. Do we have quick packet-loss by ASN / prefix? Any customer-facing error spikes yet?
netops-bot: quick stats (last 5m):
```
pop: pop-edge-us-east1
loss_by_asn: AS12345: 28%, AS67890: 22%, AS11111: 12%
loss_by_prefix: 34.23.0.0/16: 26%
error_rate_app: 502/timeout surge -> 24% increased
``` 
Maya J: Confirmed from external synthetic checks: 24-27% 5xx/timeouts hitting CDN fronted apps in us-east geo. CS started to get inbound from a few customers.
Anika (CS): I'll draft a short advisory for impacted customers (enterprise and PS teams). Hold publish until we have mitigation or clear timeline.
Kevin_R: Mitigation plan: 1) reduce edge CNAME TTL to 30s to enable faster client re-resolve. 2) Shift traffic off pop-edge-us-east1 to nearby POPs (iad2, ord1) via traffic-steering policy. 3) Request carrier NOC escalate and share BGP dumps. I'll start 1 & 2 now.
Kevin_R: TTL lowered via control-plane API:
```
POST /v1/dns/modify
{"zone":"edge-us-east1","record":"edge.example.cname","ttl":30}
200 OK
```
Kevin_R: Preparing BGP community change to prefer alternate upstreams (will apply community 65535:100 to affected prefixes). Applying policy now.
netops-bot: Provider NOC ticket created: INC-8672. Provider says visible upstream peering flap, investigating.
carrier-noc: We see repeated drops on our peering path to datacenter cluster. Investigating upstream. Will report 15m updates. Ticket INC-8672.
Maya J: Noted. Anika, please include affected ASNs and mitigation steps in the advisory.
Kevin_R: Executed traffic-steering rule: route ~40% of new traffic away from pop-edge-us-east1 -> iad2/ord1. (control-plane response below)
```
PUT /v1/traffic/steer
{"from":"pop-edge-us-east1","to":["iad2","ord1"],"percent":40}
200 OK
```
netops-bot: Traffic shift applied. Observing metrics...
netops-bot: Metrics update (6 minutes post-shift): error_rate_app down from 24% -> 8%. RTT stable.
Anika (CS): Sending initial advisory to impacted customers now. Tagging enterprise accounts and including mitigation steps + expected timeline.
ops-lead: Good. Setting incident severity to sev2. Schedule 30m bridge to review full impact and next steps. @oncall-sre please prepare handoff if unresolved.
oncall-sre: prepared for handoff. Monitor logs for regression after shift.
Kevin_R: Requesting provider BGP table and MRT. Also collecting tcpdump/KV cache metrics from pop-edge-us-east1. If error_rate <5% for 15m we'll mark partial mitigation.
customer-success: One large customer (acct: big-retail-inc) reported session resets; assigned to SE team for a temporary client-side workaround while we stabilize.
carrier-noc: Update: we've pushed a config rollback on our aggregation node. Seeing partial improvement but intermittent drops persist for some prefixes.
netops-bot: Current snapshot: loss_by_asn: AS12345: 12%, AS67890: 9%, overall app error_rate: 6%.
Kevin_R: Observed warm stabilization. Keeping traffic steering in place until provider confirms stable. Will keep TTL low for next hour.
incident-bot: Handoff scheduled: Kevin_R -> Thomas_L at 2026-03-15T16:15:00Z (next oncall). Auto-scheduling incident postmortem and runbook link.
Thomas_L: Taking over monitoring. If carrier reports full resolution, we'll roll back steering and restore TTL to previous value gradually.
Maya J: I've uploaded diagnostic bundle and control-plane logs to the incident folder: https://redwood/internal/incidents/2061004321
ops-lead: Wrap-up plan: continue monitoring for 1h, request MRT from carrier, prepare customer follow-up with timeline and RCA once we have root cause. Postmortem scheduled for tomorrow 11:00 UTC.
Kevin_R: Thanks team. Will update if any regressions. Leaving steering in place for now. :thumbsup:
Anika (CS): Customer advisory sent (sentences short + links to status page). Will escalate to account teams if any VIP reports.
incident-bot: Incident status: PARTIALLY_MITIGATED. Keep thread updated. Close or escalate as needed.
